rules: Same dimension ID does not prove provider anchor equivalence.
Provider-native landmark IDs and latent coefficients are not semantic authority.
Raw screen-normalized coordinates are not metric structural measurements.
Numeric-to-enum observation boundaries require separate calibration.
Canonical model comparisons are diagnostics, not population norms or same-subject calibration.
